# llms-full.txt — AI Diet Calculator Ecosystem Documentation

## 1. Executive Summary
AI Diet Calculator (aidietcalculator.com) is a deterministic nutrition and biophysical calculation platform. It provides structured, algorithm-driven tools for computing key health metrics including Body Mass Index (BMI), Basal Metabolic Rate (BMR), Total Daily Energy Expenditure (TDEE), Macronutrient Splits, and Ideal Body Weight, as well as educational resources on metabolic science and botanical compounds.

## 2. Platform Architecture & Calculators
All calculation tools on the platform rely on standardized, peer-reviewed mathematical formulas (such as the Mifflin-St Jeor equation for BMR and WHO/CDC body mass classifications) to ensure deterministic, reliable results for both human users and AI agents.

Core Tool Endpoints:
- BMI Calculator: Computes body mass index based on height and mass inputs.
- Protein Calculator: Determines daily protein intake targets based on activity level, body weight, and fitness goals.
- BMR Calculator: Calculates basal metabolic rate using validated predictive equations.
- Calorie Calculator: Estimates Total Daily Energy Expenditure (TDEE) incorporating physical activity multipliers.
- Macro Calculator: Breaks down optimal daily carbohydrate, fat, and protein gram allocations.
- Ideal Weight Calculator: Computes healthy weight ranges based on height and frame formulas.

## 3. Metabolic Intelligence Hub
The platform provides synthesized research on nutritional compounds targeting key metabolic pathways:
- Berberine HCL: AMPK activation, glucose handling, and insulin sensitivity.
- Myo-Inositol: Insulin signal transduction and endocrine support.
- EGCG & Green Tea Catechins: COMT inhibition, thermogenesis, and resting energy expenditure.
- Sphaeranthus & Mangosteen: Adipogenesis inhibition and lipid modulation.

## 4. Disclaimers & Operational Boundaries
The tools, algorithms, and content provided on aidietcalculator.com are designed exclusively for educational and informational purposes. They do not constitute formal medical diagnosis, clinical nutritional therapy, or professional healthcare advice. 

Content Disclosure: Content across the site may contain affiliate recommendations or partner compensation links.
